name: Juice Dollar
oneLiner: JUSD is Juice Dollar's decentralized dollar on Citrea, minted from oracle-free overcollateralized BTC positions using a Frankencoin/d-EURO architecture.
collateral: BTC deposited on Citrea (Bitcoin L2) in oracle-free overcollateralized positions; user collateral is not rehypothecated. Protocol is forked from the d-EURO / Frankencoin architecture.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting against BTC collateral on Citrea with automated on-chain liquidations when collateral ratios fall below required thresholds; no external price oracles; positions and debt are verifiable on-chain (Frankencoin-style design)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit No retained: reviewed metadata describes on-chain or overcollateralized collateral mechanics and does not identify a direct holder-balance blacklist or freeze surface on the issued token.

reserves.name: BTC collateral in oracle-free overcollateralized positions on Citrea

mintAuthority.summary: JUSD is a Frankencoin/d-EURO fork on Citrea with immutable, ownerless contracts; minting is performed by approved minter plugins and overcollateralized BTC positions that pass a qualified-holder veto period, with JUICE pool-share holders holding veto governance.

controls.label: JUSD Frankencoin-style minter registry
controls.capDescription: JUSD is minted only by registered positions/minter modules that survive the application/veto period; positions mint against overcollateralized BTC on Citrea with oracle-free on-chain liquidations. The token has no owner and contracts are immutable.
controls.evidence: JUSD is an Oracle-Free-Dollar/Frankencoin fork: immutable contracts with no owner, minting via plugins/positions accepted unless qualified pool-share holders veto during the application period.

controls.label: JUICE pool-share holder veto governance
controls.capDescription: Qualified JUICE pool-share holders (time-weighted votes) can veto proposed minters/positions during the application period and adjust certain parameters; there is no admin key able to alter the system unilaterally.
controls.evidence: Frankencoin-style veto governance: qualified pool-share holders (JUICE) can deny new minters/positions; the system is immutable with adjustable parameters but no owner/admin key.

review.evidence: Coverage and the Oracle-Free-Dollar/Frankencoin reference confirm JUSD is an immutable, ownerless Frankencoin fork on Citrea minting against overcollateralized BTC via plugin/position modules subject to a qualified-holder veto; mirrors the verified Frankencoin (ZCHF) governed-minter model.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Frankencoin-fork ownerless veto-governed minter model confirmed from coverage and the OFD reference; the live Citrea JUSD contract owner()/registry state was not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm on-chain that the Citrea JUSD contract has no owner and that minting is gated solely by the registered-minter/veto registry before raising confidence.
